question: has §CI.2's refit uplift coefficient (1.45x, computed from an unfinished run) been exceeded, and how much does correcting it move §CK.5's projected total?
SNAPSHOT_WARNING: the F2 refit may still be running, so its stage span and peak only grow. Every exact value here is a live lower bound at this timestamp, NOT a final value; re-read after seed 20260802 early-stops. The durable claims are the monotone-safe relations under durable_conclusions. This measurement is deliberately NOT byte-reproducible across runs (like §CR's).

measure_validation_against_CI_completed_.reading: the stage-span measure reproduces §CI's three completed stages exactly, so it is the same quantity §CI used and the current F2-refit span is comparable to §CI's 9.08 h lower bound

past_snapshot_reconstruction_is_unreliab.note: filtering checkpoints to mtime <= §CI's stated 17:52 gives stage span 10.00 h and seed-20260802 peak 35, whereas §CI recorded 9.08 h and peak 32; so a past live snapshot cannot be faithfully reconstructed from surviving mtimes and this probe does not attempt it -- it compares the CURRENT span against §CI's own labelled lower bound instead

completion.reading: the consistent-basis uplift (2.362x) sits between §CI's underestimate (1.45x, incomplete numerator) and the naive live overestimate (3.28x, stale denominator); seed 20260802 early-stopped at peak 71 and never approached the ambiguity region at 90, so §CR's open question resolves as NO

materiality.reading: the refit term is only ~10% of the optimistic total because k_final is ~1/10.8 of k_grid, so even though the uplift coefficient is exceeded by >= 2.27x in RELATIVE terms, the ABSOLUTE effect on the projected total is bounded at ~13%. This is the number that matters for D14's merge-timing guidance, and it is small.

durable_conclusions.monotone_safety: stage span and peak only grow for a running fit, so 'the F2 refit has run at least 20.59 h' and 'the uplift ratio is at least 3.28x' stay true forever; the exact values are snapshots and will only rise
durable_conclusions.NOT_a_final_uplift_UNLESS_complete: if the bundle is absent this is NOT the final coefficient (the fit may still be running, and computing one from an unfinished run is §CI.2's error); if the bundle is present the consistent-basis uplift is final and is reported under materiality.completion
durable_conclusions.basis_trap_avoided: §CI's 1.45x used an incomplete numerator; the naive live 3.28x used a stale denominator (6.27 h at the then-current epochs/run 33.33); the consistent basis divides the final span by the prediction at the FINAL epochs/run, giving 2.362x
durable_conclusions.materiality_bound: the correction moves §CK.5's optimistic total by ~+13% (173.5 -> >=196.2 h) because the refit term is only ~10% of it; the correction is large in relative terms but bounded in absolute terms
durable_conclusions.what_must_be_reread_after_the_refit_stop: §CI.2's 1.45x coefficient, §CK.5's four-scenario totals and ledger D14, once seed 20260802 early-stops and the F2 refit stage span is final
durable_conclusions.mtime_active_flag_is_not_authoritative: the per_seed active_within_window flag uses checkpoint mtime and will read False for a fit inside its patience window; worker_liveness_by_cpu_time is the authoritative signal. For seed 20260802 the mtime window reads inactive (>60 min since last checkpoint) while its worker is still computing, so 'stopped' must NOT be inferred from the mtime flag alone.
